description: On the green-covered surface in front of you there’s a white AirPods charging case and a short white charging cable. The right hand reaches in and steadies the AirPods case, while the left hand slides in from the left to pick up the cable tip and guide it into the port on the bottom of the case, pushing it in until it’s seated; during insertion the case is a right-hand object and the cable is a left-hand object.
